summary: Orsha Airport, also known as Balbasovo Air Base (IATA: TXC), is located near the city of Orsha in the Vitebsk Region of Belarus. Primarily serving as a military air base of the Belarusian Air Force, it has historically handled some limited civilian and charter operations. Its strategic location in central-eastern Belarus makes it a notable regional airfield.
faqs:
Q: Does Orsha Airport handle commercial passenger flights?
A: No, Orsha-Balbasovo is primarily a military air base and does not operate scheduled commercial passenger service.

Q: Is there a terminal for civilian passengers?
A: The facility is mainly military-oriented, so dedicated civilian terminal amenities are extremely limited or unavailable.

Q: Can private or charter flights use this airport?
A: Some limited general aviation or charter activity has historically been possible, but prior permission is required due to its military status.

Q: How far is the airport from the city of Orsha?
A: The airfield is situated a short distance outside Orsha, typically reachable within 15–20 minutes by road.
transport_tips: Taxis and local marshrutka (minibus) routes are the most practical ways to reach the airfield from central Orsha, as no dedicated airport shuttle service operates. Visitors should arrange ground transport in advance, as signage in the immediate vicinity may be limited due to the military nature of the base. Having a local contact or pre-arranged pickup is strongly recommended.
local_tip: If visiting the Orsha area, use the airport as a landmark rather than a travel hub—the nearby town of Orsha itself offers the Saint Barbara Church and the Dnieper River waterfront, which are more accessible and rewarding for travelers.
